QUOTE: The `interface ServerDataOperator extends …Mix` block (lines 23–38) is declaration merging. It gives the class the typed method signatures of every mixin, since the mixin classes themselves are not visible to the type checker through the class.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that a same-named interface extends the mixin types (…Mix) and, via declaration merging, types the class with every mixin's methods.
